churches.name: First Baptist Church Colorado Springs
churches.address: 317 E Kiowa St, Colorado Springs, CO 80903
churches.assessment: First Baptist Church Colorado Springs is ABCUSA (American Baptist Churches USA), NOT SBC as originally listed. This is a critical distinction. ABCUSA is a theologically diverse denomination that tends moderate-to-progressive, with openness to women in pastoral roles and varying stances on LGBTQ inclusion depending on local church autonomy. The congregation reportedly spans from theologically liberal to conservative. Founded 1872, it is the oldest Baptist church in Colorado Springs. The ABCUSA affiliation alone warrants caution — verify local theological positions carefully before recommending.
churches.denomination_detail: American Baptist Churches USA (ABCUSA) — NOT Southern Baptist as originally listed. ABCUSA is a theologically diverse/moderate-to-progressive denomination. Founded 1872.

churches.assessment: Flatirons Community Church is the largest church in Colorado, led by Jim Burgen since 2006. Burgen has a youth ministry background and entertainment-industry connections. The church is classified as 'Unclear: Non-Affirming' by Church Clarity on LGBTQ issues — they do not affirm same-sex relationships but have been deliberately unclear about their stance. The seeker-sensitive megachurch model, combined with theological ambiguity on key cultural issues, suggests prioritizing growth over doctrinal precision. Not recommended for those seeking clear theological conviction.
